verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat product, so notification tuning is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents per-channel notification settings, keyword alerts, or schedule or do-not-disturb controls. The closest item, a VISION.md line about a "Personalized feed," is an adjacent feed feature rather than interrupt or notification configuration, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can tune notifications per channel, keyword, and schedule so only what matters interrupts me
